subject: MOVE statement
notes: kb/Work/PB430.md LANDED - GR4's elementary-vs-group decision is ONE predicate asked of BOTH operands, and its no-conversion clause is ONE representation codec asked in BOTH directions. (1) THE SENDER-SIDE AND RECEIVER-SIDE ANSWERS WERE DIFFERENT. MoveClassifier.IsGroupPlace excluded every RenamesPlace on a code comment that cited 13.18.45 for the opposite of what 13.18.45.4 GR2 says ('When the THROUGH phrase is specified, data-name-1 defines an alphanumeric group item'), and MoveClassifier.Kind re-spelled the receiving half structurally instead of asking the same predicate. A RenamesPlace exists ONLY for the THROUGH form - ReferenceResolver forwards the no-THROUGH alias to the renamed item's own place, which is 13.18.45.4 GR1 - so the designation needs no further qualification, and the control arm stays elementary. MEASURED before: MOVE (66 RENAMES a THRU b) TO PIC $$,$$9.99 EDITED to $2,345.00 where the structurally identical group sender gave 12345 + spaces; MOVE (PIC S9(3) VALUE -123) TO the same alias stored 123 where the group twin stored 12L (GR6 a) drops the operational sign only in a valid ELEMENTARY move). AFTER: both pairs agree. PlaceRenderer.WriteGroupImage gained the RenamesPlace arm so the group image distributes through the WriteRenames store the Write switch already owned, never a second FromImage. (2) 'THERE IS NO CONVERSION OF DATA FROM ONE FORM OF INTERNAL REPRESENTATION TO ANOTHER' was true only of a DISPLAY sender: MoveEmitter.EmitGroupMove rendered every elementary sender with OperandText.AsString, the zoned DISPLAY image, so a PIC 9(4) COMP-3 item moved into a group deposited '1','2','3','4' in four character positions where the group-SENDER arm deposits its three representation bytes 0x01 0x23 0x4F for the very same item. Both arms now call OperandText.NonElementaryMoveSender, which is AsStorageImage for a field operand (the per-shape recipes that already define each leaf's storage - BCD, radix-2, IEEE, UTF-16BE national, packed bits) and the operand text for a literal or figurative, which has no internal representation to preserve. MEASURED: the COMP-3, BINARY and COMP-5 senders now deposit byte-for-byte what the group direction deposits, at all four editions. THE REST OF GR4 IS UNCHANGED AND STILL MEASURED: the bit/national as-if-elementary treatment (13.18.29.4 GR1b/GR2b via DataItem.IsAsIfElementary), the receiver's JUSTIFIED clause, 13.18.38.4 GR8's OCCURS carve-out on both arms, and GR9's variable-length route, which a level-66 alias cannot enter because its span is a fixed sequence of leaf widths.
